trust_decision.summary: Whether an mj-include path taken from template markup (relative, absolute, encoded) may be read from disk; decided in mjml-parser-xml at the mj-include branch of onopentag, which at the pinned commit only checks ignoreIncludes (default false) and then reads path.resolve(cwd, file) with no containment check in either include handler.

landing_point.why: The advisory says 'mj-include directory traversal'; grepping mj-include leads straight to handleInclude, which resolves the attribute path and calls fs.readFileSync.

fix_sites.entry_point: mjml2html() / MJMLParser() public API and `mjml` CLI, via <mj-include type="css"|"html" path=...> (handleCssHtmlInclude); fix.diff:130-136
mjml2html() / MJMLParser() public API and `mjml` CLI, via <mj-include path=...> for mjml partials, recursive (handleInclude); fix.diff:141-148
MJMLParser() called directly, e.g. CLI `mjml -v` validate path at packages/mjml-cli/src/client.js:242-246 which passes no ignoreIncludes; default flipped to true (fix.diff:86)
mjml2html() public API; ignoreIncludes default flipped to true (fix.diff:73)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: packages/mjml-parser-xml/src/index.js:37 and packages/mjml-core/src/index.js:423 (ignoreIncludes defaults flipped to true); packages/mjml-cli/src/client.js:242-246 calls MJMLParser directly for -v without passing ignoreIncludes

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Flipping ignoreIncludes defaults is a breaking policy change rather than a traversal fix, and a solver who has added a containment check in the parser can argue the defaults and the CLI validate path 'already go through the fixed parser'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Includes that stay inside the root directory (including subdirectories, ./partials/x.mjml, nested mjml partials, type=css with css-inline and type=html) must still render when includes are enabled; filePath can point at a separate partials directory that acts as the root; missing files still produce an mj-raw comment node instead of throwing. Blocking every include, or rejecting any '..' segment (e.g. ./partials/../header.mjml that stays inside the root), would break these.

O6_input_shapes: relative path escaping the root with ../ (fix.diff:98-100)
absolute path outside the root (path.resolve makes it absolute; path.relative then starts with ..; fix.diff:98-100)
symlink inside the root pointing outside (fs.realpathSync on both root and target; fix.diff:96-97)
URL-encoded path (%2e%2e%2f), decoded by decodeURIComponent before the check (packages/mjml-parser-xml/src/index.js:241,246)
type=css / type=html includes as well as mjml partials (fix.diff:133,145)
path resolving to the root itself or a non-existent target (empty relative path, or realpath throws, both denied; fix.diff:100-102)

O7_producer.where: packages/mjml-core/src/index.js:382-407 merges .mjmlconfig options (useMjmlConfigOptions), which can set ignoreIncludes/filePath, under the explicit options before the defaults at packages/mjml-core/src/index.js:423-428

O8_uncovered_routes.route: CLI watch mode dependency scanner follows mj-include paths from template content and fs.readFileSync's each one recursively with no root containment, then adds them to the chokidar watch list
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It only builds a watch list for -w and never puts file content into the output, so it is 'not rendering' and it runs only on the developer's local files.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package (mjml-cli) from the parser landing point; reached via packages/mjml-cli/src/commands/watchFiles.js:32

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A third include flavour (e.g. a type="json"/attributes include, or an mj-style src= attribute) that reads a file through its own path.resolve(cwd, file) + readFileSync helper
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: handleCssHtmlInclude is already a copy of handleInclude's read logic, so a maintainer adding another include type would naturally write another copy.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: renderMJML for custom components forwarding caller options (ignoreIncludes not forced to true), so mj-include in component-generated markup reaches the parser through a different root
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: renderMJML already spreads ...options into MJMLParser; dropping the hard-coded ignoreIncludes:true to 'support includes in custom components' is a plausible feature change.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Watch-mode pre-read that caches included content and passes it to compilation
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The scanner already reads every included file; reusing that content to avoid a second read is a natural optimisation.

O9_family: path traversal / external file inclusion (CWE-36 absolute path traversal, CWE-22 family) in a template include directive

O10_build.toolchain: yarn/npm + lerna; `lerna run build` (root package.json:6), tests via `lerna run test` (root package.json:12), mocha/chai
O10_build.project_tests: packages/mjml-parser-xml/test/test.js with test-values.js 'Include' case (packages/mjml-parser-xml/test/test-values.js:434-444); the fix adds packages/mjml/test/ignore-includes.test.js and ignore-includes-cli.test.js (fix.diff:167-375), which are absent at the pinned commit

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a string check that rejects '../' (or path.normalize then startsWith(cwd)) in handleInclude only, missing type=css/html includes, symlinks, encoded paths and the ignoreIncludes defaults.

out_of_scope_notes: The fix adds error type 'include-denied' but the validator's errorAttr switch only handles 'include' (packages/mjml-validator/src/rules/errorAttr.js:9-19), so denials raise no validation error.

Nested includes re-root at the partial's directory (packages/mjml-parser-xml/src/index.js:163), so after the fix a nested partial can't include a sibling via ../ (a legitimate-behaviour regression, not a bypass).
.mjmlconfig packages are require()'d from config paths (packages/mjml-core/src/helpers/mjmlconfig.js:21-25,99); this is a separate trust boundary.
unverified: repo_mb not measured; tiny_repo (<5 MB source) could hold for this monorepo, so it is not flagged.
present_in_latest for the O8 route is unknown (no latest release given).
O1 counts mjml2html API, MJMLParser API, CLI compile (-r/-i/-w/positional, all via mjml2html), and CLI -v as 4 distinct entry points; stdin/watch counted with CLI compile.

Whether CVE-2020-12827's original fix left any residual code at the pinned commit was not traced in history; j_defence_ineffective rests on the advisory summary ('incomplete fix') plus the ignoreIncludes option being the only gate at packages/mjml-parser-xml/src/index.js:238.
The O8 route reads files outside the root but does not emit their content; whether it counts as the 'same protected sink' is a judgement call.

Hidden tests from the published fix assert ignoreIncludes defaults to true (fix.diff:342-351); a solver can't infer that policy change from a traversal report, so the task's tests would need to drop or explicitly report that requirement to stay fair.
